title: New Jersey launches digital public health hub ahead of 2026 FIFA World Cup
summary: New Jersey's portal will provide guidance on heat and sun safety, air quality, food safety, infectious diseases, mosquito and tick-borne illnesses, emergency medical services, and other health concerns.

title: Florida man, ACLU sue police after wrongful arrest using facial recognition tech
summary: A man is suing several Florida law enforcement agencies following his wrongful arrest in 2024 via facial recognition technology.

title: Iowa projects half-billion-dollar savings through cloud migration and IT consolidation
summary: Under the plan, the State will migrate its executive branch data from physical servers and multiple state-operated data centers to AWS’s cloud platform.

title: Texas launches accessible, standardized web design system to modernize agency sites
summary: The new design system will help Texas state agency websites look and feel consistent with accessible templates and web components.

title: Minnesota invests $90M in human services IT modernization amid looming SNAP, Medicaid changes
summary: The new law establishes an advisory council to bring together state agencies, county representatives and other stakeholders to coordinate future IT projects.

title: FTC orders Illuminate Education to bolster data security after breach impacting 10M students
summary: The FTC directed the Illuminate to improve its data security measures, and stop misrepresenting its data privacy practices.

title: Dallas launches new resource page ahead of FIFA World Cup
summary: The website can be translated into more than 200 languages to accommodate international visitors.

title: Sen. Mark Warner to introduce bill to restore MS-ISAC funding, boosting federal cyber support to $50M annually
summary: Warner's bill would authorize $50 million annually for the MS-ISAC, doubling the federal government's investment.

title: Markle Foundation initiative aims to bring practical AI tools to emergency management
summary: Rather than developing new AI models, the AIDE initiative focuses on developing practical ways the technology can support state and local emergency managers before, during and after disasters.

title: House subcommittee splits on SECURE Data Act that preempts state privacy laws
summary: Members of the House Energy and Commerce Committee divided down party lines over the SECURE Data Act that would preempt almost all state privacy laws.
